# Xinhua: China's installed power generation capacity up 14.6% in 2024

Published: 21 Jan 2025.

## Key Findings
- Total installed power generation capacity: **3.35 billion kW (3,350 GW)** at end Dec 2024, up **14.6% YoY**.
- Solar: surged **45.2%** to ~**890 million kW (890 GW)**.
- Wind: rose **18%** to ~**520 million kW (520 GW)**.
- Power supply project investment: **~1.17 trillion yuan ($162.99B)**, up 12.1% YoY.
- Grid project investment: **608.3 billion yuan**, up 15.3%.
- NDRC + NEA document: improve regulation capacity of power system 2025-2027.
- Target: support **>200 million kW of newly added renewable energy annually** over 3 years; renewable energy utilization rate **≥90%**.
